title: IO cvars in a story level (Agent 12, dev OFF build 1): A defaults vs B five io cvars. MENU step every run (the user loads the level)
notes: Spec: perf-notes/agent12-io-memory.md, 'In-game A/B plan'. One binary (build/agent2/devoff1-bin); only the cvars differ.

Order: one unscored cold run first (Agent 12: 'discard one warm-up run'; it also warms the OS file cache for the level), then roundrobin gives A B B A A B B A A B. About 11 runs x 4.5 min = 50 min WITH THE USER AT THE PC for every MENU step; -Repeats 3 gives A B B A A B (7 runs, about 32 min).

Each run: first frame, 10 s settle, then the yellow MENU banner: load the SAME story level every run (Vorton if reachable: it exercises the PortalTrailer fixup) within 150 s and let go; then 15 s warm-up and a 20 s window standing still (Agent 12's 'stand still 20 s'), then WM_CLOSE.

Metrics: boot = the first-frame time (first frame of any kind, not the title menu); level load = post-hoc from perf.csv (Agent 12, 22:17: the build logs no level-load start or end line at the default log level; the key press that starts the load cannot be timestamped; the MENU phase is marked in proc.csv); host reads = drivers/io-counters.ps1 -> <run>\io.csv (cumulative GetProcessIoCounters: first row = everything up to the window start, i.e. boot + menus + level load; then every second to the window end). Expected: bytes equal within noise, fewer read operations in B.

Correctness, B against A: 'Fix: PortalTrailer enabled in Vorton's loading script (read-time only)' in both whenever Vorton loads; no new error or warning lines (grep NtReadFile, ReadScatter, ERROR_NOACCESS, access violation, invalid handle, assert); clean exit, no WER dialog or dump. No screenshots in this runner.

B-io (only if A and B differ): B without log_level_gate, i.e. cvars io_lockless_watch_check=true io_coalesce_scatter_reads=true io_unlocked_file_reads=true vfs_defer_open_exists_check=true. Add it as a third arm then.
pause_safe_order and debug_pause_cycle_* are not part of this A/B (Agent 11's test G). The runner always passes --pause_when_unfocused=false.
